description: Bike Racks is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Greater Geelong. Information about bike rack infrastructure in Geelong. The data includes what type of bike rack, the capacity as well as the location. Although all due care has been taken to ensure that these data are correct, no warranty is expressed or implied by the City of Greater Geelong in their use. Coverage: City of Greater Geelong. The portal files it under the publisher City of Greater Geelong. Its tags are active, asset, bicycle, bike, community. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
